Hi Sofia — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the attachments. Short answers below and next steps: 

- Eligibility: We typically approve accelerator partnerships if the program is verified and startups are early-stage (pre-seed to series A). Investor references or a program page / PDF works for verification. 
- Limits: We can do up to $5k credits per startup for cohorts but need to cap total program exposure; common approach is an accelerator promo code that auto-issues on sign-up for verified emails.
- Turnaround: If you can share a program verification doc (simple form) we can usually approve within 48 business hours and provide an issuance plan (self-serve promo codes + reporting).

Next step: Please fill the attached eligibility form (one-pager) and send back. Looping in Aditya (SE) — he’ll validate any technical usage guidance for the startups.
